data.desc: Zenta Group Company Limited is a holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands, with operations conducted in Macau through its operating subsidiaries. The Company is a professional services provider in Macau engaged in the provision of industrial park consultation services and business investment consultation services, and in the sale of fintech products and services. Its clients are primarily from the Greater Bay Area of China. Following the Company's acquisition of ZentoAI in September 2026, the Group also provides artificial-intelligence and data platform services to customers in mainland China and Asia.
